purpose: Cell atlas for Profile B. Each cell carries a role (required/optional/context/excluded) per preset and a confidence label. Morphology cited to open sources; NO invented densities/dimensions/colors. A cell is included only if relevant to the tissue+disease+experiment+purpose.

cells.morphology: flattened, ANUCLEATE, keratin-filled; bricks-and-mortar with lipid lamellae
cells.visual_rule: no nucleus; primary barrier the released API must cross

cells.cell: keratinocyte (HaCaT in the in-vitro uptake scene)
cells.morphology: viable epidermal: polygonal, nucleated, desmosomal junctions; HaCaT in vitro: spindle -> cobblestone epithelial monolayer on differentiation
cells.visual_rule: HaCaT scene = in-vitro monolayer context, labelled 'in vitro human keratinocyte model', separate from tissue

cells.morphology: dendritic cell at the stratum basale; produces melanin
cells.visual_rule: basal, dendritic; do NOT conflate with melanoma cells

cells.morphology: B16 line: monolayer, epithelial-like + spindle-shaped, melanin-pigmented (black); can form dendrites
cells.visual_rule: label as MURINE melanoma line; pigment optional; do NOT depict human invasive-melanoma histology as this model
dermal context only; not load-bearing for B1 events

cells.morphology: flat endothelium lining vessel lumen; pericytes wrap capillaries
cells.visual_rule: dermal vessels as context ONLY; no nanoparticle entry/extravasation animation for B1
label-only; not part of a supported B1 event
immune-activation cells appear ONLY in B2 ICD scene (Wang 2025), never in B1
not included - not part of the B1 evidence; decorative immune cells are prohibited

density_policy.rule: NO invented cell densities/ratios. Where a proportion is needed, use qualitative 'sparse/moderate/dense' or NOT_REPORTED. The scene must NOT place equal random numbers of every cell type.
density_policy.known_relationships: melanocytes are a minority basal population relative to keratinocytes (qualitative, OpenStax); exact ratios NOT specified for the B1 specimen -> qualitative only
